Telash Greywing is a boss in the Azure Vault. Telash initially appears as a quest giver in the Azure Span, accompanying Scalecommander Emberthal as they seek out Malygos' knowledge regarding the imprisonment of the dracthyr. Untrusting of the blue dragons or their Kirin Tor allies, Telash allied himself the Sundered Flame and broke into the Azure Vault to find the truth.
Teerai Keepers are centaur located in various places in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Some can also be found in the Emerald Dream at the Ancient Bough.
Teerai Watchers are centaur located in Maruukai, Broadhoof Outpost, and Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. They also appear in the Nokhud Offensive.
Teldrassil Bird Meat drops from owls in . The meat can be used to lure out Mowgh northeast of Wellspring Lake.

The Teldrassil Treasure Map is created by combining the Top-Right Map Piece, Top-Left Map Piece, Bottom-Right Map Piece, and Bottom-Left Map Piece found in . Use it at the hollow stump in Rut'theran Village at to find the Rune of Quick Draw.
Telescope Lens is found in Dreadsquall Nests in the Waking Shores.
Research: Niffen of Zaralek Cavern is an Azerothian Archives world quest that is unlocked upon completion of The Scale of it All. It takes place at at Igira's Watch in Zaralek Cavern.

Technoscrying: The Mysteries of the Concord Observatory is an Azerothian Archives world quest that is unlocked upon completion of The Scale of it All. It takes place at at Concord Observatory in Waking Shores.

Teele can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Completionist Outlet vendor for 600 Trader's Tender. It was originally the March 2024 completion award for filling out the Traveler's Log at the Trading Post.

Teha is a jungle troll located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal. She also arrives at Dunelle's Kindness in Hallowfall, representing the Trading Post in the trade alliance between the Hallowfall Arathi and the Council of Dornogal.

Tempered Dark Iron Plate is crafted with Blacksmithing (285); taught by Plans: Tempered Dark Iron Plate. This item can only be crafted at the Black Anvil.

Tempered Black Amnesty is upgraded from Black Amnesty#Classic at Lokhtos Darkbargainer in Blackrock Depths. The upgrade costs 25 Firelands Ember and 2 Fiery Core and requires with the Thorium Brotherhood.

Tempered Dark Iron Boots are upgraded from Dark Iron Boots#Classic at Lokhtos Darkbargainer in Blackrock Depths. The upgrade costs 15 Firelands Ember and 1 Fiery Core and requires with the Thorium Brotherhood. Since the original has random stats, several different versions of this item exist to allow the wearer to choose their stats.

Tempered Dark Iron Bracers are upgraded from Dark Iron Bracers#Classic at Lokhtos Darkbargainer in Blackrock Depths. The upgrade costs 10 Firelands Ember and 1 Fiery Core and requires with the Thorium Brotherhood.

The Tempered Banner of the Algari was rewarded during The War Within Season 1 to all teams who completed the Time Trials for the Mythic Dungeon International or The Great Push, or by completing two eligible dungeons at +5 or higher during the Break the Meta community event.

Tectonus is an earth elemental located in Featherfur Roost in the Forbidden Reach. He is summoned using the Amplified Quaking Stone on the Rumbling Deposit.
The Telescope is found between two Oathsworn Peacekeepers in Dornogal.

Technique: Patient Alchemist's Mixing Rod can be found in chests rewarded at the end of completed Delves.
Technomancer's Gift is the socket-adding item for The War Within Season 3, available from Ardgaz by the Great Vault in Dornogal for 6x Algari Token of Merit.

The Technomancers' Terrace is an area found in Manaforge Omega. It connects to Mana-Vent Aphis and Mana-Vent Batar, twin exhaust towers, in turn connected by the Gantry. Central Operations is adjacent to this area.

Temaya is the worldsoul memory of a titanic watcher located in the Isle of Dorn during Worldsoul Memory: The Worldcarvers event.

The Teerai Fisher is a centaur found at the river northeast of Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Oddly, another Teerai Fisher sometimes spawns in place of Fireheart in Teerakai proper. He stands in the flowers and emits Z's as if sleeping. File:Teerai Fisher - flower bed.jpg|Is this a cat?
Teldrassil's Sacrifice drops from Ziekket in the Blinding Vale.
Teely was a Void-infused bush chicken located near Voidlight Everdawn and Blood Knight Shan in the Twilight Highlands. It can be petted.
Telluric Leyblossom drops from rare mobs in Harandar and can also be contained in various reward chests such as Quel'Thalas Adventurer's Cache and Surplus Bag of Party Favors.
Tempered Amani Spearhead is a drop from rares in Zul'Aman. When combined with the Reinforced Amani Haft and the Toughened Amani Leather Wrap it creates the Amani Warrior's Spear.

The Tempered Blade is created by quenching the Heated Blade in the Well of Eternity in . It can be used to summon The Will of the Ashbringer.

Temporal Investi-gator is a crocolisk located in Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus. To make him spawn, first complete Melly Teletone's questline starting with Time, Signature. After completing Feats Per Minute, head back to Everywhen Inn and talk to Melly to obtain Melly's Metronographer+++. Head downstairs to Bartender Bob and use the Metronographer, which summons Bartender Blob. Buy Infinitea from the ooze, then quickly head (30 seconds duration!) to the waterfall outside Eon's Fringe at and drink the tea there to summon a Time-Soaked Clock. Activating the clock summons the crocolisk.

The Temporal Missive: The Servant Emperor is one of the temporal missives needed for the A Dark Iron Past achievement. This missive spawns after defeating General Angerforge.

The Temporal Missive: The Grim Guzzler is one of the temporal missives needed for the A Dark Iron Past achievement. This missive spawns after defeating Phalanx who spawns after getting near the Grim Guzzler entrance.

The Temporal Missive: Martial Law is one of the temporal missives needed for the A Dark Iron Past achievement. This missive is available in the Domicile by default but it is out of the way. In the room where Phalanx spawns, go in the opposite direction and through the very last door (basically opposite side of the ring from the Grim Guzzler and Phalanx spawns. There are no mobs to worry about in this section.

In the room where Phalanx spawns, go in the opposite direction and through the very first door on the left. There are mobs in the way to access this missive.

Tempest Keep Reforged is an achievement earned for defeating Kael'thas Sunstrider in Tempest Keep on Titan Reforged.

Tempest's Shelter drops from the Sentinel of Winter in the Den of Nalorakk.
Tempestuous Sandals drop from Xathuux the Annihilator in Murder Row.

The Temporary Untethering Apparatus is a device located in any neighborhood where Consortium Consternation is the current endeavor. It appears in the Town Center in Founder's Point or the Common in Razorwind Shores. It was invented by Stezi'ce. Stepping into the apparatus will activate it, moving the player into untethered space after a few seconds: : Phase Wading can be removed by right-clicking the buff, leaving the area, speaking to Stezi'ce, or approaching the apparatus again and clicking the extra action button.
Temporal Barrier is a Preservation evoker talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Nozdormu's Teachings.
Tempest Keep Cryo-Pod is housing decor created with Outland Engineering (60). The recipe is taught by trainers.
Temple Delver's Mystic Helm has a chance to drop from trash mobs in the Venomous Abyss.
Temporal Hiccups is obtained from the Wild Arcana at the Cobalt Assembly.

Temple Fishing is a warband-wide buff given after the completion of Venom Fishing: Maximum Potency. It allows adventurers to fish in the deepest and most dangerous areas of the Temple of Ula'Tek on the Coiled Isle. In doing so, it also makes available fishing pools in the rivers of venom there that were not previously visible. The pools include Viscous Venom, Vile Venom, and Vile Oddities.
Terra is a gnome standing next to Caeli and Cronym on the second floor of the Photonic Playground in Dalaran. It is currently unknown if she survived Dalaran's destruction. __NOTOC__
Tenured Archivist is a reputation achievement earned by becoming a Tenured Archivist with the Azerothian Archives in the Dragon Isles, the equivalent of standing with the faction.
Tenebrous Epiphany teaches the Mind Sear (priest rune) rune for gloves.
Territorial Rockborers are magma serpents located in Zaralek Cavern.
Tephratennae is a large cinderbee located in Cinderwold on the Isle of Dorn.
The Terror of the Forge is a deepstrider located in the Earthenworks in the Ringing Deeps.

Tenir's Ascent is the main airship dock of the Hallowfall Arathi, located in south-central Hallowfall. A dawntower stands at the northwestern end, and the Dawnbreaker is permanently docked here. Players are initially directed here in Rally on the Dawnbreaker, midway through the first chapter of the Hallowfall storyline, to help fight off a continuous Kaheti assault. The entry portal to the dungeon the Dawnbreaker is at at the northwestern end of the airdocks, and the Tenir's Traversal skyriding race is at to the southeast. The area is bordered by the Fangs to the north, the Stagnant Mire to the northeast, the Whispering Pool and Sanguine Grasps to the east, Beledar's Bounty to the west, and
Territorial Skimmers are water striders located in the Emerald Dream.
Terror Whelps are green whelps located in Forest Song in during Nightmare Incursions.
Territorial Instincts is a hunter class talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Guttural Roar.
Terrace Attendants are earthen located in Thraegar Rest and Keepers Terrace in Dornogal. They are seen cleaning crystals.
Terminal Attendants are brokers located in the Tazavesh Customs Enforcement in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Terrestrial Cache is located in the Resonant Peaks in Zereth Mortis.
The Terrace of Formation is an area in Zereth Mortis. The Devoured Cache is found here.
The Terrace of Majesty is a barracks that hangs near the southern rampart of the Nerub-ar Palace. The Kili-zar Arena is here.

The Terrace of Reanimation is the final area in the Darkmaul Citadel dungeon on Exile's Reach. It is here that Gor'groth, leader of the Darkmaul clan of ogres, intends to resurrect the dragon Ravnyr. A rainstorm initially pours down on the terrace; once Gor'groth's ritual has been thwarted, the sky clears. The terrace is accessed by a ramped hallway leading up from Bonebreaker Hall. Darkmaul Channelers with groups of Decaying Corpses in the hallway defend against intruders.
Terrestris is a quest reward from Commit to Quality. It can be transformed into a version with more defensive stats.
Territorial Deepwalkers are deepwalkers located in Azj-Kahet.

Territorial Lashers are lashrooms located in Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet.
Tera Heartstrings is a goblin child located at Slam Central Station in the Undermine.

Tentacle Spokes are used to craft a Voidflame Wheel, of which two are required to make the Felreaver Deathcycle from Horrific Visions Revisited. Spokes are found in Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom). The wheels also require: * 1x Voidflame-Resistant Hide — Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom) * 6x Entropy Enhancer — Khaz Algar engineering This makes one wheel, and two are required.
Territorial Woodwings are ducks located in Sundapple Copse in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The Terror of the Wastes is a voidscythe mount. At Renown level 19 with the K'aresh Trust, it can be purchased for 11,375 Resonance Crystals from Om'sirik in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market on K'aresh.
Terrified Traders are brokers located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
The Terror of the Night is a voidscythe mount rewarded by the achievement Vigilante, which requires completing all of the Warrants on K'aresh.
Terraformer's Seal is a quest reward from Watch me Make These Bugs Expire.
Tenured in the Timeways IV is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing Infinite Research assignments, then speaking with Eternus to accept your promotion to Principal Chronoquery Investigator.

Tenured in the Timeways I is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing five Infinite Research assignments, then speaking with Eternus to complete Infinite Research Promotion: Timely Assistant and accept your promotion to Timely Assistant.
Tenured in the Timeways III is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing Infinite Research assignments, then speak with Eternus to accept your promotion to Senior Executive Chronographer.
Tenured in the Timeways II is a Legion Remix achievement earned by completing Infinite Research assignments, then speaking with Eternus to accept your promotion to Honorary Chronographer.
Territorial Eagles are eagles located at the Pitch in Algeth'ar Academy.

The Tenebrous Harrower is a harrower mount rewarded by Glory of the Midnight Raider, a meta-achievement that requires completing various tasks in the Voidspire, Dreamrift, and March on Quel'Danas raids.
Terrifying Gronnlings are gronnlings that attack Frostwall and Lunarfall during goren Garrison Invasions.
Terrinor is a bat located in Thalassian Range in Eversong Woods.
Tenets of the Twilight's Blade was a tome found in Dunwald Ruins in the Twilight Highlands.
Tented Cobweb is housing decor that can be purchased for from Klasa in Founder's Point and Lonomia in Razorwind Shores.

They can also be looted from a School of Gems, which is created with Midnight Alchemy.

Terrastra is an ally card from the Twilight of the Dragons set depicting Terrastra.
Thaelin's Spare Wrench likely belongs to Thaelin Darkanvil and might have been used at Blackrock Station in Gorgrond.

Tess's Peacebloom is awarded to players who complete the Gilneas Reclamation storyline, ending in What We Left Behind or The Wall Between Us. Non-worgen players will need to relog after completing the quest before the toy will silently show up in the Toy Box. The toy is a reference to Curse of the Worgen Issue 5, where Tess ventured up to her father's observatory in Greymane Manor with a single :peacebloom flower. She reminded Genn the words he would tell her as a little girl, and that even among the ruined Gilneas she was able to find an unharmed peacebloom, which gave them both hope.
Tethercoil Rune is provided by Lydiara Whisperfeather for Handling It: Taut Tethercoil.
Thak's Treasure is located in Storm's Watch on the Isle of Dorn. It is revealed by One-Eyed Thak after playing the question game with him.

The Thalassian priesthood is an order of blood elf (formerly high elf) priests in the kingdom of Quel'Thalas. Ill-suited for the rigors of combat, the priests' role is to preserve life and illuminate their comrades in the splendor of the Holy Light. As holy field medics, they roam the battlefields curing the wounds of fallen comrades.
Thalassian Sunguards are blood elves located at the entrance to the Sunwell plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
Thalassian Fillet is a crafting reagent used in Midnight Cooking.

Thalassian Phoenix Tail has a chance to drop from herb nodes in zones, up to 1 each week. It can only drop after all 5 for the week have dropped. When used, it grants 4 points of Midnight Herbalism Knowledge.

Thalassian Phoenix Plumes have a chance to drop from herb nodes in zones, up to a maximum of 5 each week. When used, they grant 1 point of Midnight Herbalism Knowledge. After all 5 Thalassian Phoenix Plumes have dropped, the weekly Thalassian Phoenix Tail can drop.

Thalassian Phoenix Embers act as catchup knowledge for Midnight Herbalism. After all of the current week's other knowledge sources have been completed (Thalassian Phoenix Plume, Thalassian Phoenix Tail, and Botanist Nathera's quest), Thalassian Phoenix Embers have a chance to drop from any herb node, up to the current Midnight Herbalism Knowledge cap.
